paite: Huan Ahab in Samaria ah tapa sawmsagih anei hi. Jehu in Samaria a, Jezreel kho heutute, upate leh Ahab tapate ana dontei mite kiang ah, laigelh in akhak hi.
heading: Ahab Suante Thah Ahi Uh
english: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,

paite: "Hiai laikhakte na muh phet chiang un, na pu tapate na kiang uah a-om ua, kangtalaite, sakolte, kulhpi nei khuate leng, galvante toh na nei uhi.
english: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,

paite: Huchi in na pu tapate lak a mi, ahoihpen leh akizenpen zongkhia unla, apa laltutphah ah tusak unla, na pu uh inkote a ding in gal dou un," achi hi.
english: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

paite: Himahleh amau alau mahmah ua, "Ngai dih ua, kumpipa nihte'n azoh louhsa uh ahi a, e'n bangchi in i zou mahmah dia?" achi uhi.
english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

paite: Kumpipa insung heutupen, khopi ukpen, upate, naupangte ana dawntei mi teng in Jehu kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh, hih dia na hon hilh tengteng ka hih ding uh. Kuamah kumpipa in ka bawl kei ding uh; nang hoih na sakdan in hih in," chi in mi asawl uhi.
english: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”

paite: Akiang uah, "Kei lam a pang na hih ua, ka thu na man ding uleh na pute uh tapate lu hon la unla, zingchiang in hichih hun ma in Jezreel ah ka kiang ah hong un," chi in lai akhak nawn hi. Kumpipa tapate sawmsagih ahi ua, khopi miliante, amau dontei mite kiang ah a-om uhi.
english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

paite: Laikhak amuh un hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa tapate aman ua, sawmsagihte athat ua, alute uh bawmpi a koih in Jezreel ah akiang ah akhakta uhi.
english: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.

paite: Thangkou khat ahong tung a, "Kumpipa tapate lu ahon tawita uh," chi in ahilh uh. Ama'n, "Kulh lutna kongpi gei ah mun nih in sekhawm unla, zingchiang tan in om hen," achi hi.
english: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”

paite: Azingchiang in hichi ahong hi a, ava pawt a, adingh a, mi tengteng kiang ah, "Noute diktat hi un, ngai un, ka pu ka guksawm a, ka hihlumta a; ahihleh hiai tengteng kua thah ahia le?
english: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

paite: TOUPA'N Ahab inkote tungtang agen, TOUPA thu lei ah ake het kei ding chih thei un; TOUPA'N asikha Elijah zang a agen ahon tungsakta hi," achi hi.
english: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Yahweh’s word, which Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For Yahweh has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”

paite: Huchi in Jehu in Jezreel a Ahab inkuan a mi omsun teng, amilian tengteng, alawm tengteng leh asiampute khat lel leng hawisak het lou in athat siang vek hi.
english: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

paite: Huchi in athou a, apawt a, Samaria ah ahohta hi. Lampi a belampute belam mulmetna inn ava tun in,
heading: Kumpipa Ahaziah Tanaute Thah Ahi Uh
english: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

paite: Jehu in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah unaute amu a, "Kuate na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Ahaziah unaute ka hi uh, kumpipa tapate leh kumpinu tapate chibai va buk dia paisuk ka hi uh," chi in adawng uh.
english: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hingmat un," achi a; huchi in ahingmat ua, belam mulmetna inn khukchin ah athat ua, mi sawmli-le-nih ahi ua; khat lel leng ahawi kei uh.
english: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.

paite: Huai a pan apawt nung in Rekab tapa Jehonadab, amah dawn dia hong pai amu hi. Chibai abuk a, akiang ah, "Na tung a lungsim dik ka put bang in, lungsim dik na pu sam hia?” achi hi. Jehonadab in, “Pu e,” chi in adawng hi. "Ahihleh na khut hon pe dih," achi a; huchi in akhut apia a, ama'n akiang ah kangtalai sung ah akailut hi.
heading: Ahab Tanau Om Lai Teng Thah Ahi Uh
english: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hong sam inla, TOUPA a dia phatuam ka ngaihdan mu himhim dih,” achi hi. Huchi in akangtalai ah atuangsak hi.
english: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for Yahweh.” So they made him ride in his chariot.

paite: Samaria ava tun in Ahab inkote Samaria a omsunte, Elijah kiang a agen TOUPA thu bang ngei in, ahihman khit vek masiah athat zel hi.
english: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Elijah.

paite: Jehu in mite tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah, Ahab in Baal nna sem zek phet ahi a, Jehu in bel nakpi in asem ding hi.
heading: Baal Bemite Thah Ahi Uh
english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

paite: "Tu in Baal zawlnei tengteng, abemi tengteng leh asiampu tengteng ka kiang ah hon samkhawm dih ua. Kuamah kim lou kei uhen; Baal kiang ah kithoihna thupitak lat ding ka nei a; kuapeuh akim lou ahing het kei ding," achi hi. Himahleh Jehu in Baal bemite hihlup tum in, gitlouh piltak a, ahih ahi.
english: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

paite: Jehu in, "Baal min in khawmpi thupi bawl un,” achi hi. Huchi in agenzakta uhi.
english: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.

paite: Jehu in Israel gam tengteng ah akhakkhia a; huchi in Baal bemi tengteng ahong pai ua, atel lou himhim a-om kei uhi. Baal inn ah alut ua; Baal inn kongpi a pan aphaitam pha in adim dipdep uhi.
english: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

paite: Kivatna puan kemmi kiang ah, "Baal bemi tengteng kivatna puan hon la in," achi hi. Huchi in kivatna puante ahon la uhi.
english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

paite: Rekab tapa Jehonadab toh Baal inn ah Jehu alut ua; Baal bemite kiang ah, "Hiai ah Baal bemite lou ngal, TOUPA mite a-om kha ding uh, zong unla, en vialvial dih uh," achi hi.
english: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of Yahweh are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

paite: Kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte lan dia alut un, Jehu in inkuan ah mi sawmgiat ana dingsak khin hi. "Na khut ua ka hon piak kuapeuh asuahtakleh, asuaktami hinna tang a amah hinna lak ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”

paite: Haltum thillat alat khittak in hichi ahong hi a, Jehu in galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh kiang ah, "Lut unla, va that un; kuamah suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in namsau in asat ua; galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh apaikhia ua, Baal inn ah alut uhi.
english: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.

paite: Baal inn a milimte alakhia ua, ahal uhi.
english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

paite: Baal lim alaichim ua, Baal inn ahihsia ua, tuni tan in dailenbuk in azang lai uhi.
english: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

paite: Huchibang in Jehu in Israel gam a pan Baal ahihsia hi.
english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

paite: Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna, Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, ahihte Jehu in atawpsan kei hi. Huai bel Bethel khua leh Dan a dangka-eng bawngnou limte biak ahi.
english: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

paite: TOUPA'N Jehu kiang ah, "Ka mit tungtak a thil na hih ziak leh ka lungsim a deihthusam bangtak a Ahab inkote tung a na hih ziak in, na tapate suan lina tan in Israel laltutphah ah atu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

paite: Himahleh Jehu in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian dan alungtang tengteng in azui kei a; Jeroboam in Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahihkhelh atawpsan tuan kei hi.
english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahweh, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N Israel gam letdan aneusak panta hi. Huchi in Hazael in Israel gam tengteng ah amau anuaisiahta hi.
heading: Jehu Sihna
english: In those days Yahweh began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

paite: Jordan a pan suahlam, Gilead gam tengteng, Gadte, Reubente, Manassehte, Arnon Phaizang a Aroer a pan Gilead leh Vasan gam tan in.
english: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

paite: Jehu tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihtheihdan tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Jehu api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoahaz ahong lalta hi.
english: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

paite: Samaria gam a Israelte tung a Jehu vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-giat ahi.
english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.
